title: Wildwood Water Sports kayak and canoe rentals (Located in Shubie Park)
specs: Historic Shubenacadie Canal and Lake Charles location
All renters must be 16 or older or have a parent/guardian complete waiver and accompany them
Children must be at least 5 years old to ride in canoes; children 2 and older allowed in kayaks when accompanied by adult
Children must be accompanied by adults who are confident swimmers
Everyone must wear a properly fitted life jacket at all times
Renters must be physically capable and free of medical or emotional conditions that could cause harm
Group rental discount applies to all boat types for groups of 8 or more, booked in advance
includes: PFDs and safety equipment included with every rental
gap: Maximum weight limits per boat type not fully stated on booking page
blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards to explore the historic Shubenacadie Canal and Lake Charles. The waters are beginner-friendly and dogs are welcome. Safety equipment including life jackets is included with every rental.
extraNote: Open weather permitting; check weather and call or text to confirm hours · Group rental discount for groups of 8 or more, must be booked in advance · No ATMs onsite; preferred payment by e-transfer or cash accepted · Waiver required before rental; renters accept risks and release liability · Abandonment or rescue of equipment will result in a fee; late returns incur additional charges · In a little boathouse down by the water near the Fairbanks Centre in Shubie Park · Open weather permitting, fall hours stated
